fields.System.Title: TRF-4 — In-transit management
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Keep track of stock that belongs to neither site, and make sure that anything which does not
arrive gets noticed.

Scope

In. In-transit reporting, ageing and escalation, discrepancy recording and investigation.

Out. Insurance claims. Carrier disputes.

Design notes

TRF-402 is not optional polish. It is the only thing that will ever detect stock lost in
transit. A transfer dispatched and never received sits in the virtual location indefinitely:
neither site has the stock, neither site is missing it, and the network total is overstated by
the lost amount — permanently and silently.

Build the ageing report at the same time as the transfer flow, not after the first loss.

Never auto-adjust a discrepancy. The origin dispatched 100, the destination received 95.
Auto-adjusting makes the symptom disappear and guarantees the cause persists — whether that
cause is theft, a picking error at origin, or a receiving error at destination.

TRF-404 makes it an investigation record with an owner and an outcome. The resolution then
posts the adjustment, attributed to the actual cause.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Stock lost in transit, never detected | [doc 09 §9.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Discrepancy auto-adjusted | [doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| In-transit stock counted as available | [doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
